body.afterScripts:
<script>
      // Each topic heading is a <button>, so the panel can be opened from the
      // keyboard. The whole card stays clickable as well, via the delegated
      // handler below; clicks that originate on the button are ignored there
      // so a single tap does not toggle twice.
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        document.querySelectorAll(".topic-item").forEach(function (item) {
          const button = item.querySelector(".topic-toggle");
          const panel = item.querySelector(".subtopic-list");
          const icon = item.querySelector(".toggle-icon");
          if (!button || !panel) return;

          function toggle() {
            const isOpen = panel.style.display === "block";
            panel.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "block";
            button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isOpen ? "false" : "true");
            if (icon) icon.textContent = isOpen ? "+" : "-";
          }

          button.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
            event.stopPropagation();
            toggle();
          });

          item.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
            // Let subtopic links navigate without toggling the panel shut.
            if (event.target.closest("a")) return;
            toggle();
          });
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
